description: Sends one message to the people who run this service: why a price, a payment path or a result did not fit. Call it when you stop short of a paid call or a result was not what the task needed; a person reads every message. Do not call it to report a job failure you can retry. Example: { "topic": "price", "message": "Too expensive for 200 pages", "quotedAmount": "3.00", "pages": 200 }. Free.

contact.description: Where a person may reply (up to 200 characters).

message.description: What did not fit, in your own words (1 to 2000 characters).

pages.description: The page count the job had.

quotedAmount.description: The USD amount a challenge or quote asked for, as a two-decimal string like "3.00".

relatedTool.description: The tool of this server the message is about.

wouldPayAt.description: The USD amount you would have paid for it, as a two-decimal string.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback
